items.title: Do young people consider themselves healthy?
items.excerpt: In 2025, 89.7% of young people aged 16 to 29 in the EU perceived their health as good or very good. This was clearly higher than the share in the total population aged 16 and over, at 67.9%. items.title: EU income inequality: Gini coefficient at 29.2 in 2025
items.excerpt: In 2025, the EU’s Gini coefficient was 29.2, down slightly from 29.4 in 2024.
